parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or feature configurations. This parameter takes effect only if the functionName parameter is passed.

Valid values:

*   global
*   rule

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 500.

parameters.name: RouteName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter takes effect only when parameter functionName is specified.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-site-routes --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096980000 --config-type global --route-name test_route --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListSiteRoutes --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --RouteName test_route --ConfigId 352816096980000 --ConfigType global
